text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Quality-monitor (evals) has flagged a sudden degradation correlated with cost-routing change at 09:20 UTC. Error rate up, and automated eval score drop. Paging on-call for routing / fallback incident :rotating_light:

Sunita: picking this up. seeing increased low-quality signals on /generate-prod, which started ~09:20 UTC. Any recent policy pushes?

Marco: yes, ops pushed a cost-routing policy change at 09:18 that added a low-cost variant (variant-c-quant2) as eligible for 'economy' tier. it got >40% of traffic via routing rules.

Eli: confirm: manifests show policy v2.7 rolled at 09:17:36 by ci/cd. Logs show a burst of requests routed to variant-c-quant2 starting 09:19:40.

Riley: customer-quality-monitor shows 15% drop in per-token BLEU-like metric for a set of regression prompts; latency improved but quality unacceptable. several customers filed errors & bad outputs.

Sunita: immediate mitigation plan: 1) remove variant-c-quant2 from economy pool 2) create an emergency deny rule 3) throttle fallback routes to avoid loop. who can apply?

Marco: I can patch the policy. applying emergency deny now.

Marco: (patch) ```yaml
- id: deny-quick-econ-variant
  rule: deny
  match: variant == "variant-c-quant2" && route == "economy"
  priority: 1000
```

ops-bot: POLICY CHANGE: deny-quick-econ-variant applied by Marco at 09:29:12 UTC. Previous policy v2.7 -> v2.8.

Eli: confirming routing tables: traffic to variant-c-quant2 dropped to ~0% after policy. fallback engine attempted region fallback twice but respected deny.

Riley: telemetry: quality metrics starting to recover by 09:40, but some sessions are still degraded because of cached prefixes routed earlier. prefix cache purge recommended for impacted customers.

Kate-CS: we have ~12 customers reporting quality regressions via CS tickets, 3 escalated. I'll inform them we're rolling back the cheap variant and working to restore outputs.

Sunita: temporary mitigation complete. marking severity P1->P2 as customer-visible but contained. I will stay on for handoff.

incident-bot: HANDOFF: Sunita to hand off to Marco for long-running follow-up at 10:15 UTC. Pager duty note created (PD-INC-6543).

Marco: follow-ups: - run a canary for quantized variant with stricter eval thresholds - add explicit quality threshold in routing policy to prevent auto-promotion - add cooldown on routing changes so a new rule cannot immediately shift >20% traffic

Eli: creating infra ticket to add a quality-check gate in the routing orchestrator. also adding a cache invalidation job per customer when a variant change is rolled.

Sunita: captured immediate customer impact: 12 customers, 3 escalations, estimated 18k requests affected over 20 minutes, mean eval drop 15%. No revenue loss yet but risk to SLAs.

Kate-CS: I'll send a status note to affected customers: high-level explanation + ETA to resolution (15-30m while caches clear).

Riley: action items assigned: Marco owns policy rules & cooldowns, Eli owns orchestrator gate & cache purge, Kate-CS owns customer comms, Sunita owns postmortem & severity assessment.

Sunita: adding quick runbook entry for on-call: if quality regression + routing change detected, do: 1) apply deny rule for suspect variant 2) throttle auto-fallback 3) purge prefix cache 4) notify CS 5) create incident record.

Marco: note for follow-up: audit why policy v2.7 allowed quantized variant without quality threshold. looks like a config drift in model-catalog.

Eli: creating link to logs and evals: https://internal.redwood/evals/1901234567 and routing diffs: https://internal.redwood/routing/diffs/1901234567

Sunita: good job team. moving to monitoring mode. we'll reconvene in the postmortem channel after 24h to define permanent fixes. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: temporary mitigation applied, monitoring mode enabled. PD-INC-6543 transitioned to follow-up.

Sunita: final note before handoff: do not re-enable variant-c-quant2 in economy until it passes the extended evaluation suite and we've added routing quality checks.

Marco: acknowledged. will create a gated rollout plan with explicit metrics.

Eli: logging action items in infra backlog now.

Kate-CS: customers notified. I'll share copies of the messages in #customer-updates for record.

Sunita: handing off to Marco now. thanks everyone. :handshake:
